name: Houston Tankin
description:
At a time when our spaceships are travelling through the universe, a new star has lit up in the racing tank building — Houston Tankin. The members of this team are progressive thinkers of their time, who know a lot about technologies of the future. High-speed cars that withstand the effects of extra high and cryogenic temperatures can bring a triumphant victory to their owners. 
Thanks to innovative ideas and an extraordinary approach, the creators of this racing team have formed the following motto: "Houston, we have no problems."
